versions.name: George W. Pirtle Scout Reservation

features.note: one wheelchair-accessible campsite with a sidewalk and a power outlet for medical use
open-air council ring with a stage and seating for the opening and closing campfires
covered archery range
four shower houses with hot and cold running water
air rifles offered alongside the smallbore range
a-frame open-concept chapel used for daily non-denominational services
counsellor-in-training program for older campers
forty-two-foot tower used for the climbing badge
unit service projects arranged with the camp director
COPE course paired with a zip line
cafeteria-style service with troop table waiters
first-year camper area and a dedicated first class trail session
covered handicraft area for art, wood carving, leatherwork, and basketry
health officer on duty around the clock
marked hiking trails on the property
ecology and conservation pavilion covering forestry and geology
paddleboards at the waterfront
program pavilions for the first-year, outdoor skills, and ecology areas, plus a covered stage building
large pool with a deep end and individual dressing rooms
maverick Scouts without a unit are adopted by a provisional troop for the week
rappelling from the climbing tower
covered smallbore range
rowboats at the waterfront
outdoor skills pavilion
covered shotgun range
pool swimming plus lake waterfront
camp store with supplies, snacks, and badge pamphlets
slide into the camp pool
lake frontage with a boat marina
wood carving in the handicraft area

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident summer camp of the East Texas Area Council near Gary, Texas, offering a first-year First Class Trail program and an aquatics program.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types.
